## Looking for

In priority order:
1. Product engineering
2. Product management (APM / PM)
3. Data & analytics
4. Full-stack development
5. Founder's Office

Interested in: consumer products people return to, AI-native products, data-driven teams, deep tech and space.
Best at: taking a fuzzy problem to a shipped, measured product with a small team.

## Summary

Computer engineer who works at the intersection of engineering and product. Hired as a developer at an early-stage US startup and grew into owning features end to end: requirements, UX, architecture, deployment and post-launch analytics, without a PM, designer or handoffs. When the company went through a rough patch and the team was let go, he was the one retained. Left a campus-placement job at Capgemini after 11 days to build at a startup.

## Experience

### Tekkers AI — Full-stack developer (de facto product owner)
Aug 2025 – present · Houston, TX, USA (remote)
- Owned 10+ features end to end across a consumer sports fan app and a B2B venue dashboard.
- Live Predictions: score forecasting, live leaderboard and check-in gating, built from scratch; became the app's #1 user-acquisition driver within weeks.
- Personalised For You feed: single-bootstrap + 30-second polling architecture tailored to each user's favourite teams; handled all iOS/Android edge cases solo.
- Communications tab for venue operators: automated event reminders, friend-invite nudges, fill-the-spots campaigns.
- Push notifications end to end: delivery pipeline, topic routing, read/unread logic, low-latency schema.
- Product analytics in PostHog across 17 screens: funnels, cohorts, DAU/WAU; automated daily digests to the team.
- Also owns UI/UX, graphics and product demos for 5–6 screens, including revenue-generating games.

### Capgemini — Software engineer
Jul 2025 – Aug 2025 · Navi Mumbai. Campus placement; left after 11 days to join a startup.

### Unsquare — UI/UX intern
May 2025 · Thane, Mumbai (on-site). Wireframes and high-fidelity Figma prototypes for mobile and web.

### GrapheneAI — Data intern
May 2024 – Jul 2024 · Bangalore (remote). AI pipeline testing, data cleaning and scraping, chatbot parameter testing.

### Outlier AI — Language contributor
May 2024 – Jul 2024 (remote). Wrote, ranked and edited prompts and responses to train AI models.

### VESIT — Summer intern
May 2024 – Jul 2024 · Mumbai. Co-built PictoNarrot, an app that helps children with special needs learn language through narrated stories.
